precision: FP32 master / BF16 autocast / SDPA math
selection: development accuracy only; ties prefer fewer steps then lower LR

predictor_plan.priority_metric: fraction of paired oracle accuracy gain retained, and difference from warmup
predictor_plan.matched_gradient_control: mean:4current update rows +16predictor_dev rows;20truegradientexamples/update. RetainoracleLR/stoppingcontrolandaddselectedpredictorLR/stoppingcontrol;deduplicateifidentical. Seed101diagnostics only. Gradientexposurebudgetmatchesadaptiveatthesamesteps,notfrozen.

notes: 11-hour wall-clock budget including GPU wait, preparation, training and final evaluation.
Reuse dataset splits and prompts from the completed 0.5B study for cross-model comparison, but train independent 1.5B adapters and predictors.
No final-result-based retuning. Previously examined benchmark populations make this exploratory evidence.
Do not rerun completed equivalent 1.5B experiments.
At most one GPU; no foreign process intervention.
statistics: Final paired source-group and update-seed bootstrap, conditional on one fixed warmup; family size is the currently declared benchmark scope, with separate intervals including registered oracle recipe extensions.

oracle_confirmation.used_for: binary predictor admission only, not choosing LR or checkpoint
oracle_confirmation.criterion: Fixed development-selected recipe; mean of3update seeds greater than the same fixed warmup. No individual-seed/base-model/CI gate.
oracle_confirmation.criterion_before_user_mean_rule: Historical rule only; not active in this study

gpu_allocation_policy: At most one physical GPU; shared execution permitted when sufficient headroom exists, bounded worker allocator and no padding while shared; reserve an empty GPU at a safe worker boundary; never stop foreign processes.
resource_wait_budget_policy: Measured resource waiting shifts planned oracle admission, capped at deadline minus 5 hours; the hard 11-hour wall-clock deadline and final-evaluation reserve remain fixed.
gpu_identity_scope: Initial actual assignment for descriptive purposes; per-stage authoritative assignments are in results/stages and resource logs.
